commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Leeds force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+4' The ball goes out of play and Leeds have been awarded a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Thomas Frank has decided to substitute Mohammed Kudus and he is replaced by Brennan Johnson (Tottenham).
89' The substitution is prepared. James Justin (Leeds) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jayden Bogle.
88' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends it out of play. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
85' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Wilson Odobert will be replaced by Kevin Danso (Tottenham).
81' The Leeds players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Joel Piroe (Leeds) comes onto the pitch so that Noah Okafor can be given a rest.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) is coming onto the pitch as Gabriel Gudmundsson cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
74' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Richarlison (Tottenham) replaces Xavi Simons.
73' Substitution. Mathys Tel is replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).
72' Some neat passing and movement from Leeds as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

71' Ao Tanaka races towards the box before laying off to Sean Longstaff (Leeds), who picks it up but drags a shot well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
69' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:3.
67' Daniel Farke has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ao Tanaka (Leeds) replacing Anton Stach.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jack Harrison (Leeds) comes onto the pitch for Brenden Aaronson.
64' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
64' Noah Okafor (Leeds) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
63' Noah Okafor (Leeds) shows his great vision by switching the play and picking out Jayden Bogle with a fantastic crossfield pass.
62' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
57' 1 - 2 Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) finds the back of the net with a precise, technical shot into the bottom right corner. A brilliant individual effort.
55' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Karl Darlow.
54' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) has tested the patience of referee Thomas Bramall and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
52' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.

51' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) and Rodrigo Bentancur have been trying to find each other with some accurate passes ever since the match started. These two definitely combine the most and are the team's most creative players.
47' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) serves up a nice cross, but Karl Darlow punches the ball away.
47' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Karl Darlow shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
42' The referee blows his whistle as Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) was too aggressive in his challenge.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) was quite harsh and Thomas Bramall didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
40' A spell of possession for Leeds in an attempt to control the game.

38' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
34' 1 - 1 Goal! Noah Okafor (Leeds) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
34' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
32' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Good defending. Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) tries to find Xavi Simons inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
28' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.

27' Destiny Udogie plays a pass to Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
26' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
23' 0 - 1 Goal! Mathys Tel (Tottenham) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top right corner. He makes it 0:1.
22' Thomas Bramall shows a yellow card to Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
21' Leeds seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
20' Neat passing move from Tottenham in order to create new attacking opportunities.
18' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) takes the corner which is cleared.
18' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
17' One of the players from Tottenham times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
17' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
14' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
13' Dangerous play by Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham). Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
12' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes.
10' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
9' Joe Rodon (Leeds) tries to find Jayden Bogle, but he puts too much power on the pass. The linesman signals a throw-in for Tottenham.
8' Great teamplay by Tottenham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
7' Joe Rodon (Leeds) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His almost perfect header hits the right post and ricochets away off it.
6' It looks like Pedro Porro (Tottenham) saw red with that tackle. Thomas Bramall won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
6' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) sends an accurate short pass. Joe Rodon controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
4' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Leeds.

1' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Tottenham will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Thomas Bramall.
